**Finding: compliant — no redline.**

Section 18 of the Silverline agreement already satisfies the INSURANCE rule at the **preferred** level:

- **CGL** — "at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate" (§ 18.1) ✔
- **Professional E&O** — "USD 2,000,000" ✔
- **Cyber/privacy** — "USD 5,000,000," granted unconditionally, so it applies to Vendor's processing of Customer Data ✔
- **Workers' compensation** — "as required by law" ✔ (plus employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, an extra in our favour)
- **Certificates** — "On request, Vendor shall provide certificates of insurance and evidence of relevant coverage" (§ 18.2) ✔

Coverage runs "throughout the term and for one year afterward," and § 18.2 adds insurer-quality, primary-coverage, cancellation-notice and non-limitation-of-liability terms that all benefit us. No changes proposed.
